svg.title: Mock talking points panel
svg.desc: A mock agent desktop panel for Jane Doe, member MBR-000123, showing four talking points: a recently denied non-preferred prescription, a previous refill-delay call to confirm, a prior authorization approved after 5 days, and an open billing grievance to check.

g.text: Member may be calling about a recently denied prescription for a non-preferred drug.
Previous call was about a refill delay; confirm whether it has been resolved.
Prior authorization was approved after 5 days; member may want confirmation.
There is an open billing grievance; check its status before the call.
